sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Kashmiri Meenakari Bracelet Watch for Women
sourceNotes.rawContent: A timeless fusion of function and tradition — this stunning Kashmiri-style bracelet watch features intricate meenakari work, pearl accents, ghungroo bells, and vibrant coloured beads on a multi-strand gold chain. Perfect for weddings, festivals, sangeet, and ethnic occasions where you want to stand out effortlessly.
